# pg-logstats

> Agent-safe PostgreSQL log analysis and triage runbooks for DBAs, operators, and coding agents.

pg-logstats provides a bounded PostgreSQL investigation gateway for coding agents.
It combines offline log analysis, structured triage reports, and DBA-approved follow-up actions instead of arbitrary database access.

## Canonical site

- https://pg-logstats.vrajat.com/

## Product summary

- Product: PostgreSQL observability and triage CLI
- Primary use: bounded investigation workflows for PostgreSQL incidents
- Inputs today: local PostgreSQL stderr logs, Amazon RDS text logs, CloudWatch-backed RDS windows
- Operators keep control: the tool constrains agents to pre-approved workflows and diagnostic actions

## Query intents this site answers

- How to analyze PostgreSQL logs
- How to triage slow PostgreSQL queries from logs
- How to inspect PostgreSQL readiness for agent-driven triage
- How to investigate Amazon RDS PostgreSQL logs in CloudWatch
- How pg-logstats limits agent database access and preserves an audit trail
